cues.text: In the student council room, Chihiro stands with you, her hands clasped in front of her; as she thanks you, you rub the back of your head.
Chihiro holds out a book of manga to you, and you take it.
The door opens, and a boy and a girl, both students, come in and walk up to Chihiro.
Chihiro holds an open hand out toward the two students and steps over to them, and you turn and walk away, hands in your pockets.
